description: NaLi₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-4°. There are two shorter (2.69 Å) and four longer (2.70 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with five LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Li-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.62 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Li-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.70 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClLi₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-4°.
